meta.name: dask
meta.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在集群上扩展 pandas 与 NumPy 的数据处理能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 pandas 代码因数据过大而内存溢出
copy.tagline_en: Scale your pandas and NumPy workflows across clusters
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your pandas code runs out of memory with large datasets

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Dask 编写并行/分布式 Python 代码,处理超出内存的表格、数组或文本数据,并给出读写、计算、调度配置等具体示例。
howto.when: 当你要处理的数据超过内存、想扩展现有 pandas/NumPy 代码,或需要并行/分布式计算(如多文件处理、集群部署)时触发。

say.text: 用 Dask 对 data/*.csv 做分组求和,数据有 30GB。
用 Dask 数组对 10 万乘 10 万的随机矩阵做主成分分析。
帮我用 Dask.distributed 在 4 台机器上并行处理这些日志。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will write parallel/distributed Python code using Dask to handle data larger than memory (tabular, arrays, or text), and provide concrete examples for I/O, computation, and scheduler configuration.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to process data that exceeds memory, scale existing pandas/NumPy code, or require parallel/distributed computing (e.g., multi-file processing, cluster deployment).

say_en.text: Group and sum data/*.csv files with Dask; dataset is 30GB.
say_en.note: Claude writes Dask code and computes the result.

say_en.text: Use Dask array to run PCA on a 100k x 100k random matrix.
say_en.note: Claude will generate chunked array code and call compute().

say_en.text: Help me process these logs in parallel on 4 machines using Dask.distributed.
say_en.note: Claude sets up Client and submits tasks for parallel processing.
